the proposed clustering method with SDM measures is robust and effective for nucleus cytoplasmus separation and it can be used to improve classification of leukaemia images.
the SDM based clustering algorithm outperforms the other clustering algorithms and the proposed system achieves high classification accuracy using the proposed SDM clustering algorithm.
the proposed intelligent decision support system achieves superior classification rates for acute lymphoblast leukaemia diagnosis.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a decision support system for the diagnosis of acute lymphoblastic leukemia.
the development of a novel clustering algorithm for robust segmentation of microscopic blood images, and the application of a number of classifiers for lymphocyte/leukaemia diagnosis.
the development of an effective and efficient decision support system for leukaemia diagnosis.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the SDM clustering algorithm, in conjunction with the Dempster Shafer classifier, is the most accurate approach for lymphocyte/ lymphoblast classification from microscopic blood images, and hence the proposed system is a useful decision support tool for leukaemia diagnosis.
the proposed intelligent decision support system is capable of providing a robust and reliable diagnosis for leukaemia patients.
the proposed intelligent decision support system is able to provide an efficient and reliable tool to assist pathologists in the diagnosis of leukaemia from microscopic images.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed system is able to achieve high accuracy and robustness in the diagnosis of ALL from microscopic blood images using the SDM based clustering and Dempster Shafler ensemble classifier.
the proposed clustering algorithm is robust and effective in separating nucleus and cytoplams of lymphocytes/ lymphoblasts from the background.
the system is able to produce robust segmentation and accurate classification of lymphocytes/ lymphoblasts.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed SDM clustering algorithm is robust to the variations in the shape, size and colour of nucleus and cytoplasms of lymphocytes and lymphoblasts.
a combination of SDM and GA clustering with SVM classifier can be used to develop a reliable and robust system for leukaemia diagnosis.
the proposed SDM clustering algorithm with its novel between cluster evaluation is a promising method to segment nucleus and cytoplplasm from blood images.
